source.custom: Backgrounds: feat only, no ASI (2026-11-06 ruling).

system.description: When you enter a ruin, historical site, or location of cultural significance you can identify its original purpose, its builders, and its approximate age without making a check. When you have access to a library, archive, or historical record, research on any topic takes you half the normal downtime. You also gain advantage on History checks related to events that occurred more than 50 years ago..
